name: Darlaston Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Darlaston Community Centre. Open Tue and Thu for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Wolverhampton Council Allotments
short_description: Wolverhampton Council allotment sites in Darlaston area
description: Council manages sites at Darlaston and Wednesbury. Plots from £25/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage facilities.

name: Darlaston Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at King George V Park
description: Volunteer-run community garden within King George V Park. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Open weekends during growing season.
